gloss: number of flat objects (sheets, tickets, etc.)

definitions.explanation: The count or quantity of flat, thin objects such as sheets of paper, tickets, photographs, plates, or cards. Derived from the counter {枚|まい} (for flat things) plus {数|すう} (number).

examples.japanese: コピーの{枚数|まいすう}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the number of copies.

examples.japanese: チケットの{枚数|まいすう}が{足|た}りない。
{写真|しゃしん}の{枚数|まいすう}が{多|おお}すぎて、アルバムに{入|はい}りきらない。
examples.english: There are too many photos to fit in the album.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of the counter {枚|まい} (for flat objects) and {数|すう} (number). Used when discussing quantities of flat items without specifying the exact count. Similar in construction to {本数|ほんすう} (number of long objects) and {個数|こすう} (number of pieces).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {枚数|まいすう}を{数|かぞ}える: to count the number of sheets
- {枚数|まいすう}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the number of sheets
- {枚数|まいすう}{制限|せいげん}: limit on the number of sheets
- {枚数|まいすう}が{足|た}りない: not enough (sheets/tickets/etc.)
